title: Korean Kanakaraju
plot_overview: A man finds himself possessed by a Korean spirit and must grapple with a new supernatural identity. As he tries to protect his family, he also sets out to solve the mystery of the spirit’s murder.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like supernatural stories that mix family stakes with a murder mystery, such as Conjuring Kannappan or Virupaksha; Not for you if you prefer grounded, non-supernatural plots.
review_summary: Pros: supernatural premise; family stakes; murder mystery | Cons: limited plot details; no review consensus
